item.title: Too Old for the Queue
item.description: A 96-year-old woman who joined the long queue at the People’s Park in Davao City on Tuesday (16 December 2025) for her ₱10,000 cash gift from the Office of the Senior Citizens’ Affairs was forced to lie down on plastic chairs to rest after developing back pains while waiting for her turn for over two hours. MindaNews photo by RUBY ROSE L. LORA
